ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Project delivery, Defects period and later stages need Actual completion, Retention held and Retention release date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Pre-start", 1, "Mobilising", 2, "On site", 3, "Snagging", 4, "Defects period", 5, "Closed out", 6, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(Actual_completion_date__c), ISBLANK(Retention_held__c), ISBLANK(Retention_release_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Actual completion, Retention held and Retention release date before moving to Defects period.
